extensionDescription.message: A Firefox extension for speed reading

contextMenuStart.description: Context menu item to start speed reading.

controlPanelNoSelectionErrorMessage.message: Click on or select some text before activating this extension
controlPanelNoSelectionErrorMessage.description: Error message shown in the control panel when the user tries to start a speed reading session without selecting any text.

controlPanelButtonOpenSettings.description: Tooltip for the button that opens the settings page.

controlPanelButtonTogglePause.description: Tooltip for the button that toggles pause/resume of the speed reading session.

controlPanelButtonIncreaseWPM.description: Tooltip for the button that increases the words-per-minute (WPM) of the speed reading session.

controlPanelButtonDecreaseWPM.description: Tooltip for the button that decreases the words-per-minute (WPM) of the speed reading session.

controlPanelButtonClose.description: Tooltip for the button that closes the speed reading session.

optionsPageHighlightSettingsHeader.description: Header for the section of the options page that contains settings related to the highlight.

optionsPageHighlightBackgroundColorLabel.description: Label for the setting that controls the highlight background color.

optionsPageHighlightTextColorLabel.description: Label for the setting that controls the highlight text color.

optionsPageResetLabel.description: Label for the button that resets the highlight colors to their default values.

optionsPageResetButton.description: Tooltip for the button that resets the highlight colors to their default values.

optionsPageDelaySettingsHeader.description: Header for the section of the options page that contains settings related to delays.

optionsPageShortDelayMultiplierLabel.description: Label for the setting that controls the multiplier for short delays.

optionsPageLongDelayMultiplierLabel.description: Label for the setting that controls the multiplier for long delays.

optionsPageHyphenatedWordLengthThreshold.description: Label for the setting that controls the length threshold for hyphenated words to be treated as multiple words.
Units for the hyphenated word length threshold setting.
